v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Make a joyful noise * before the Lord our King.
Lord, * thou hast been our refuge. ‡
O Lord, * thy mercy is in heaven.

text.la: Pópulus meus, * ait Dóminus, bonis meis adimplébitur.
text.en: My people, * said the Lord, shall be filled with good things.
To our God * be joyful and fitting praise.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: In sanctitáte * serviámus Dómino, et liberábit nos ab inimícis nostris.
text.en: In holiness * let us serve the Lord, and he will deliver us from our enemies.

text.la: Da, quǽsumus, Dómine, pópulo tuo diabólica vitáre contágia: et te solum Deum pura mente sectári.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, grant thy people grace to withstand the temptations of the devil, and with pure hearts to follow thee the only God.

text.la: Beáta es, María, quæ credidísti: perficiéntur in te, quæ dicta sunt tibi a Dómino, allelúia.
text.en: O Mary blessed art thou that didst believe! for there shall be a performance of those things which were told thee from the Lord. Alleluia.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Deus, qui per gloriosíssimam Fílii tui Matrem, ad liberándos Christi fidéles a potestáte paganórum nova Ecclésiam tuam prole amplificáre dignátus es: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, quam pie venerámur tanti operis institutrícem, eius páriter méritis et intercessióne, a peccátis ómnibus et captivitáte dǽmonis liberémur.
text.en: O God, Who didst use the glorious Mother of thy Son as a mean to ransom Christ's faithful people out of the hands of the unbelievers, by enriching thy Church with yet another family, grant, we beseech thee, that we who reverently honour her as the Foundress of that great work, may for her sake and by her prayers, be redeemed from all sin and all bondage unto the evil one.

office.title: Feria Quinta infra Hebd XVII post Octavam Pentecostes III. Septembris
